SUED FOR BEING MY FAVOURITE CHOCOLATE.

I genuinely don’t even know how we got this close, or how our conversations gradually became something I look forward to. But one thing I know for certain is that my sense deserves some credit for making us start talking. 😂

There’s something quite fascinating about you. Your calmness, your discipline, your respectfulness… I could go on, but honestly, I haven’t quite found the appropriate vocabulary yet.

You’re just like a perfectly written character who somehow made his way into real life.

And I don’t mean perfect in the sense of being without flaws. I mean there’s something about the way you carry yourself, the way you think, and the little things that make you who you are.

I admire your mind as much as I admire your person. Perhaps that’s why talking to you never feels like just passing time. There’s always something to discover, something to laugh about, or something that leaves me thinking long after the conversation ends.

And your lips? Well, let’s not even open that case. The evidence is overwhelming. 😂

I just know that I’m genuinely glad our paths crossed.

So, Akinola Olashile, consider this your official notice: you are appreciated, admired and ridiculously cherished by someone who happens to think you’re quite extraordinary.

Case closed? Absolutely not. There’s still plenty of evidence to present.
